title: Gray types aboard craft and Coburn's handler

tellings.quote: Um I remember seeing um mostly different types of grays um on board uh on board the craft.

plain: A guest named Steve Colbern, who describes himself as a witness, says he remembers being on board a craft and seeing "mostly different types of grays" there. Grays are the small, gray-skinned beings with large heads and eyes that often appear in accounts of alien abduction. Colbern tells Michels this as his own memory, on an episode about a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies.
